name: Nucleoside transport and mitochondrial membrane permeabilization
rationale: Most members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport across membranes, joined by mitochondrial depolarization/outer-membrane permeabilization and apoptosis terms that the drug-ADME and nucleotide-interconversion confusables lack.

qualifier: caspase-4/5 and NLRC4 against enteric bacteria
name: Caspase-4/5 and NLRC4 inflammasomes against enteric bacteria
rationale: Members cover CASP4/CASP5 inflammasome assembly and substrate cleavage, the IPAF (NLRC4) inflammasome, pyroptotic inflammation and enterobacterial antagonism, distinguishing them from AIM2/NLRP3/IL-18 pyroptosis confusables.

name: E2F target transcription promoting cell cycle phase transitions
rationale: All members are E2F target/G1-S transcription programmes and positive regulators of G1/S and G2/M transitions, unlike confusables centred on RB/CDK4/6 control, DNA replication initiation or the G2/M checkpoint.

qualifier: by incretins, fatty acid and cholinergic receptors
name: Incretin and nutrient receptor stimulation of beta-cell insulin secretion
rationale: Members are glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and its potentiation by GLP-1/GIP incretins, FFAR1 fatty acid receptors and acetylcholine in beta cells, whereas confusables emphasise glucagon/somatostatin receptors, adrenergic inhibition or KATP channels.

name: Canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling via destruction complex and TCF
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt signaling, from FZD/DVL and AXIN destruction-complex regulation (including cancer mutants and drugs) to TCF/LEF target gene control, distinguishing it from non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ and Notch confusables.

qualifier: trabeculation, endocardium and coronary vessel development
name: Trabecular myocardium, endocardium and coronary vessel development
rationale: Members cover ventricular trabeculation and cardiomyocyte development together with endocardial differentiation and coronary vasculogenesis, which the valve/septum and cardiomyocyte-proliferation confusables lack.

qualifier: glycinergic inhibition and neuronal translation control
name: Neuronal excitability, glycinergic inhibition and neural translation control
rationale: Members share control of neuronal signaling (action potentials, calcium channels, glycinergic transmission, MECP2-GABA, neural mRNA translation) and sensory-driven behaviours, while confusables focus on MECP2 regulation or locomotor behaviour.

core: Eicosanoid and fatty acid oxidative metabolism
name: P450 omega-hydroxylation, epoxygenation and 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid metabolism
rationale: Members are oxidative metabolism of eicosanoids and fatty acids by CYP omega-hydroxylases, epoxygenases and 12-LOX/hepoxilin routes (including CYP4F22/SLC27A4 skin defects), unlike confusables focused on lipoxins, 5-LOX leukotrienes or lipid transport.

qualifier: glycolysis with phosphocreatine buffering and oxygen transport
name: Glycolytic ATP supply with phosphocreatine buffering and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine glycolysis with creatine/phosphocreatine energy buffering, mitochondrial ATP/ADP exchange and oxygen transport, which the glycolysis-regulation and gluconeogenesis confusables lack.

name: Glucose, fructose and glycerol metabolism via glycolysis and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glucokinase and glycogen regulation, glucose-6-phosphate transport, fructose and glycerol/alditol metabolism, distinguishing them from pentose/galactose and glycogen-synthesis disorder confusables.

name: Spliceosomal snRNA transcription and pre-mRNA splicing
rationale: Members span snRNA transcription by Pol II/III, snRNP cap hypermethylation, spliceosome assembly and splicing regulation, whereas confusables cover histone mRNA processing, RNA decay or Pol I/III transcription.

core: Sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
name: SRF-regulated sarcomere assembly and striated muscle contraction
rationale: All members concern myofilament organisation and striated muscle contraction, and the SRF-target actin/contraction modules are exactly what the confusables lack.

qualifier: class I and II, with HIV immune evasion
name: MHC class I/II antigen processing, presentation and HIV evasion
rationale: Members cover proteasomal processing, MHC class I loading, cross-presentation, MHC class II and CD1 presentation plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of CD4/MHC-I, broader than the NKT, DC-signature or PD-L1 confusables.

name: NGF signaling through TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members are NGF production/processing, p75NTR complexes and TRKA downstream signaling (FRS2, ARMS, ERK5, PI3K, CREB), distinguishing it from TRKB/TRKC and p75NTR death-only confusables.

qualifier: gonad, sex determination, prostate and mammary gland
name: Gonad, reproductive tract and mammary gland development
rationale: Members cover sex determination, gonad, genital tract, prostate and mammary gland development, unlike confusables centred on lung/salivary branching, germ cells or pancreas.

name: Phosphatase-mediated ERK inactivation and MAPK negative feedback
rationale: Members describe ERK inactivation by threonine/tyrosine dephosphorylation and feedback suppression of MAPK signaling, whereas confusables cover RAF/RSK activation or IL-6/ERK activation.

name: HIV-1 transcription elongation, pausing and Tat-mediated recovery
rationale: All members are HIV-1 transcript elongation with or without Tat, including pausing, arrest and recovery, while confusables are generic host Pol II initiation and elongation.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven chemokine production and myeloid chemotaxis
rationale: Members combine formyl peptide receptor neutrophil responses with CXCL1/2, CCL2/3/5 production and granulocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing them from neutrophil migration/apoptosis and DC-cytokine confusables.

qualifier: ryanodine receptor release and cytosolic calcium clearance
name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release and cytosolic calcium clearance in striated muscle
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor calcium release, Na/Ca exchange and calcium sequestration that set relaxation, contraction and heart rate, unlike confusables centred on SERCA import or positive inotropy/chronotropy.

qualifier: with outflow tract and great artery formation
name: Heart valve, septum and outflow tract-great artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT, valve and septum morphogenesis plus neural crest-dependent outflow tract, aortic, pulmonary and coronary artery formation, which the myocardial and heart-tube confusables lack.

name: Retroviral DNA integration, viral latency and host restriction
rationale: Members cover HIV DNA integration and circle formation, viral latency, HCMV events and host restriction (APOBEC3G, LRRFIP1, transcriptional suppression), distinguishing them from retroelement silencing and HIV entry/reverse-transcription confusables.

name: Linkage-specific polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitinase editing
rationale: Members are E1/E2 ubiquitin activation, K6/K27/K29 chain formation and linkage-specific deubiquitination by USP, OTU and metalloprotease DUBs, unlike NF-kB, neddylation or E3-ligase confusables.

qualifier: rod, bipolar and amacrine cells and lamination
name: Retinal lamination and rod, bipolar and amacrine neuron differentiation
rationale: Members are retinal layer formation and differentiation of rod photoreceptors, bipolar and amacrine neurons, whereas confusables cover photoreceptor maintenance/cones, dendrite self-avoidance or eye morphogenesis.

qualifier: hair follicle, sebaceous and mammary gland, nail
name: Ectodermal appendage formation of hair follicles, glands and nails
rationale: Members cover placode-derived ectodermal appendages (hair follicle, sebaceous and mammary gland, nail) and epidermal morphogenesis, distinguishing them from keratinocyte differentiation and tooth confusables.

name: TLR9/IRF7-driven type I interferon production in dendritic cells
rationale: Members are TLR9 regulation, TRAF6-IRF7 activation, DEx/H helicase sensing and IFN-alpha/beta production in activated dendritic cells, unlike the RIG-I/MDA5 and IRF3-centred confusables.
